summary: The 2023 end-of-year episode reviews a remarkable recovery from 16k to 42k, driven largely by BlackRock ETF anticipation. Both hosts see 2024 as potentially starting with a Q1 dip followed by boringly bullish sideways consolidation in the 35-45k range, rather than going straight to all-time highs. Extreme sentiment swings created great trading conditions. Both acknowledged missing major opportunities in Solana and Link due to altcoin laziness. Altcoin season signals are bullish with open interest flipping BTC.
